span.label: mechanisms
span.term: successive laminar sinks track a shift in which afferents dominate: first feedforward input from lower visual areas into middle layers, then local and top-down associative input onto superficial layers
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: the first feedforward volley is too brief to unblock NMDA receptors, so it cannot support plasticity and therefore cannot show repetition effects
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: repetition effects emerge from sustained polysynaptic interaction across an extended cortical network rather than from local plasticity at one synapse
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: the late component of repetition suppression is produced by withdrawal of excitatory drive onto deep cortical layers, seen as a simultaneous collapse of the deep sink and the deep-layer firing

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: the lateral-to-medial reversal of the repetition sign marks a division of labor, with lateral avTL supporting facilitated (primed) processing and entorhinal cortex supporting active recollective retrieval

span.label: an initial sink in the middle layers is read as feedforward input from lower visual areas, because those layers are where such input terminates

span.note: RETRACTED: DIRECTION REVERSED - THE LAYERS PRODUCE THE PEAK. The edge is `peak --causes--> layer`. The span says 'the initial sharp sink in LAYER IV combined with a source in layers II/III Quotation withheld, whereas the late source in layer IV combined with a sink in layers II/III would be expected to produce a surface negative potential peaking at ~600ms.' The laminar sink/source configuration is the cause and the peak is its consequence, twice over, in one sentence. WHAT THE SPAN DOES SAY (Q-309): the same relation with the arrow reversed. Found by TOOLS/audit_common_cause.py, an enrichment that returned only 4 rows in 984 live `causes` edges - the class it targets leaves no lexical trace, which is why this was found by reading a small queue rather than by detecting anything. Its sibling Halgren2006[28] `CSD --causes--> MEG` was read in the same pass and LEFT: the span does assert that a sink/source pattern PRODUCES the potential, so that edge is sound. — strength of the relation: 1
